messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Gooood morning{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Actually,
{07 16 00}it hasn't been good. I'm not
my usual peppy self.
{07 00 00}See, I wanted to start
this all-fruit, like,
detoxifying diet today?
{07 11 00}But since the weather is so
gloomy, I'll just have to
wait until tomorrow.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Teeere hommikust{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Tegelikult {07 16 00}pole see hea
olnud. Ma pole oma tavaline
reibas mina. {07 00 00}Vaata, ma
tahtsin täna alustada
sellist puuvilja-
puhastusdieeti? {07 11 00}Aga kuna
ilm on nii sünge, pean
homseni ootama.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Goood morning{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}Tell me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}why are you
staring at my face?
{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}is it my clothes?{01 00 00 0a 00} Did I
misread you again?{01 00 00 0a 00} Geez,
{07 06 00}I'm, like, so embarrassed!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Teere hommikust{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}Ütle,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}miks sa
mu nägu jõllitad?
{07 04 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}kas asi on riietes?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Kas sain valesti aru?{01 00 00 0a 00} Ohh,
{07 06 00}mul on, nagu, nii piinlik!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oh, boy, {01 00 00 05 00}I don't usually say
this about ANYTHING, but{01 00 00 05 00}
rain is so mean!
{07 06 00}I took such trouble to
dress up today, too,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Oi issand, {01 00 00 05 00}ma ei ütle seda
MITTE MILLEGI kohta,{01 00 00 05 00}
aga vihm on nii tige!
{07 06 00}Ma nägin täna nii palju
vaeva, et end ilusaks teha,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Helloooooo{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Know what?
{07 16 00}When it's raining, I'm just
not into {04 16 00}...
{07 0f 00}It makes me feel kind of
blue!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Halloooooo{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Tead mis?
{07 16 00}Kui sajab, ei ole ma
üldse {04 16 00} lainel...
{07 0f 00}See teeb mind kuidagi
kurvaks!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Oh, no, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! {01 01 00}{07 16 00}I was
gonna take a walk and visit
another town today.
But this rain will turn me
into {04 01 00} soup in,
like, two seconds flat!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Oi ei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! {01 01 00}{07 16 00}Ma pidin
täna jalutama minema ja
teist linna külastama.
Aga see vihm teeb minust
{04 01 00} supi, nagu,
kahe sekundiga!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Good evening!{01 00 00 05 00} You know,
{04 1f 00}, it's important
to look on the bright side.
Like today! {01 00 00 05 00}Yep, it's
raining, but now we don't
need to water the flowers.
{07 06 00}But on sunny days, {01 00 00 05 00}it's a
different story. That's what
I have my {ff 00 00 07}watering can {ff 00 00 00}for!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tere õhtust!{01 00 00 05 00} Tead,
{04 1f 00}, on tähtis
näha asju helgemalt.
Nagu täna! {01 00 00 05 00}Jah, sajab,
aga nüüd ei pea me
lilli kastma.
{07 06 00}Aga päikeselistel päevadel {01 00 00 05 00}
on teine lugu. Selleks mul
{ff 00 00 07}kastekann {ff 00 00 00}ongi!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thanks for coming to see
me,{01 00 00 0f 00} even in all this gross
weather, {04 1f 00}!
Don't you wish this rain 
was {04 18 00}
instead?! {01 00 00 05 00}YUM, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aitäh, et tulid mind
vaatama,{01 00 00 0f 00} isegi sellise
jubeda ilmaga, {04 1f 00}!
Kas sa ei sooviks, et see
vihm oleks hoopis {04 18 00}
?! {01 00 00 05 00}NÄMM, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}HOPPIN' HOTCAKES!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}it's
you, {04 1f 00}! {07 00 00}I know
you like chilling with me.
{07 06 00}But you should go change
out of those wet clothes
first! {01 00 00 05 00}You freaked me out!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}HÜPLEVAD PANNKOOGID!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}see
oled sina, {04 1f 00}! {07 00 00}Tean,
et sa tahad minuga olla.
{07 06 00}Aga sa peaksid esmalt need
märjad riided ära vahetama!
{01 00 00 05 00}Sa ehmatasid mind!
